channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Bonnie Raitt will kick off the Minnesota State Fair grandstand series
item.description: Tickets for her first fair gig in 10 years will go on sale Jan. 30.

item.title: KFAN’s Paul Allen apologizes for on-air comments about ‘paid protesters’
item.description: The longtime Vikings announcer is taking a few days off after facing national criticism.

item.title: As tensions rise after shooting, federal judge considering request to temporarily halt Operation Metro Surge
item.description: U.S. District Judge Kate Menendez said the matter is top priority.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves’ losing streak ends with 108-83 victory over shorthanded Warriors
item.description: The Wolves dominated a game without either Anthony Edwards or Stephen Curry and ended their five-game slide.

item.title: Chris Madel ends GOP bid for governor, says he can’t support federal ‘retribution’ against Minnesota
item.description: His exit comes as some other Republicans have started to distance themselves from the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown in the state.

item.title: New Fairview deal provides at least $600M for U of Minnesota health programs
item.description: The 10-year agreement funds the U Medical School plus research and clinical care while investing $1 billion in medical facilities on the university campus.

item.title: Judge hears arguments over whether federal government will preserve evidence in Pretti killing
item.description: Judge Eric Tostrud took the issue under advisement and promised swift resolution.

item.title: Walz and Trump speak by phone as White House appears to soften tone on ICE crackdown
item.description: Both parties described the call as productive. The governor’s office said Walz asked for “impartial investigations” into the fatal shootings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti.

item.title: Border czar Tom Homan’s arrival in Minnesota signals shift by Trump administration
item.description: Homan’s assignment comes amid reports that some federal immigration agents will soon be pulled out of Minnesota.

item.title: The latest: Some federal agents will start leaving Tuesday, Frey says after phone call with Trump
item.description: The apparent move by the administration comes as White House border czar Tom Homan is dispatched to take over the federal immigration operation in Minneapolis.
